purpose: Diagnostic/probe set to test whether structured data helps when records actually fire. This is not a new blind held-out set.
interpretation_rule: Do not use this set as held-out generalization evidence. Use it to diagnose target, paraphrase, completeness, near-miss, and control behavior around existing structured records.

design.target_records: Direct, paraphrase, and completeness questions targeting the 7 existing structured records.
design.near_miss: Same-document or over-trigger questions that should reveal whether record matching is too broad.
design.controls: Questions from documents without structured records, used to ensure normal RAG behavior is still measured.
